verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Node.js can be written at any point of a workflow, with access to most npm packages and step-data helpers like $.export. The official GitHub README confirms Node.js, Python, Golang and Bash code steps with package imports. Community users corroborate code-based workflows and the addition of Python support in the 2.0 release. Missing for 10: dedicated first-party Python code-step documentation in the pack (Python is evidenced only via the README and community).
